scope: Actual public TEXT4 native HTTP disconnect during unfinished 8192-token prefill and cold recovery, one observation per width.
limitations: One observation per width; no latency percentile or worst-case guarantee.
Disconnect is observed after a completed chunk while prefill remains active; it does not prove the signal arrived during a particular GPU command.
Different public source revisions: this is a bounded lifecycle check, not an isolated performance comparison.
No broad image, width, or full-model FP32/BF16 fidelity qualification.
